Only LICENSE, README.md and common/ are kept (the USB full-speed device, CDC serial control endpoint and SPI-flash bridge).
The board tops, tests and the tinyprog programmer are upstream. fpga/tools/prepare_usb_core.py makes the synthesis copies.
